avoid_supplements.name: Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine) - High dose
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Pyridoxine is a cofactor for AADC, accelerating peripheral conversion of levodopa to dopamine, reducing CNS bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplemental B6 >25 mg/day; patient should maintain consistent dietary B6 intake

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May antagonize dopaminergic effects and worsen Parkinson's symptoms; hepatotoxic potential compounds risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue kava kava supplementation prior to or during levodopa therapy

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and may reduce levodopa-carbidopa efficacy; potential serotonergic interactions increasing psychosis risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; allow 2-week washout if transitioning

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe (S-Adenosyl Methionine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May deplete dopamine via COMT-mediated methylation pathways, potentially reducing levodopa efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for reduced therapeutic response

caution_supplements.name: Iron Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May chelate or compete with levodopa absorption in GI tract, though clinical significance is variable
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; monitor symptom control

caution_supplements.name: Calcium Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May form complexes with levodopa reducing absorption, particularly at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Administer levodopa-carbidopa 2 hours apart from calcium products

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce levodopa absorption through chelation or altered GI pH
caution_supplements.action: Space dosing by 2+ hours; monitor for efficacy changes

avoid_foods.name: High-protein meals (especially animal protein)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Neutral amino acids compete with levodopa for LAT1 transporter-mediated intestinal and BBB absorption, significantly reducing bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Take levodopa-carbidopa 30-60 minutes before or 2+ hours after protein-rich meals; separate protein intake from dosing windows

avoid_foods.name: Fermented foods (sauerkraut, tempeh, miso)
avoid_foods.mechanism: High tyramine content may increase blood pressure when combined with levodopa-carbidopa due to potentiation of sympathomimetic effects
avoid_foods.action: Limit intake; monitor blood pressure; avoid excessive consumption

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods and beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may compete with levodopa transport and potentially increase dyskinesias or tremor in some patients
caution_foods.action: Monitor tolerance; limit to moderate intake (≤200 mg/day caffeine)

caution_foods.name: Whole grains and high-fiber foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive fiber may slow GI transit and reduce levodopa peak levels, though modest amounts are generally well-tolerated
caution_foods.action: Consume at separate times from medication; maintain consistent fiber intake

monitoring_notes: Patient education on protein timing is critical for maintaining consistent levodopa efficacy; serum vitamin B6 levels should be monitored periodically, especially if dietary sources vary. Regular assessment of motor symptom control and dyskinesia severity helps detect absorption or interaction issues.
